scope: Static stock suitability review; no circuit substitution, timing promotion or full-supply/load qualification.

hc377.finding: Data and clock reach AL1 U6/U7 through CMOS-output AHCT244 and HCT574 drivers; enable is driven by AHCT00. U7 unused data inputs are grounded. No direct EPROM-to-HC input in these paths.
hc377.dc_screen: At the shared 4.5 V datasheet point, AHCT244/AHCT00 VOH >=3.8 V at -8 mA and HCT574 VOH >=3.84 V at -6 mA exceed HC377 VIH 3.15 V. This is a bounded DC screen; supply extremes, output current/loading, receiver crossing, clock/data skew and timing remain unqualified.
hc377.disposition: Plausible reuse candidate, pending exact timing model and integrated loaded-signal checks; retain CD74HCT377E selection.

gates.conditions: 4.5 V, CL=50 pF, SN74 -40..85 C columns
gates.disposition: Same NAND/AND functions and DIP pin assignments, but HCT delay bounds cannot inherit AHCT timing. Recompute clock gating, pulse widths, setup/hold and reset paths before substitution. Slowing the oscillator alone does not prove hold/glitch behaviour.

decoder.document: Philips 2004-10-12, ordering page and DIP24/SOT101-1 outline
decoder.disposition: Owned decoder option for four positions; historical DIP-24 documentation found. Manufacturer/logo and count still unknown. Retain CD74HCT154E selected identity until exact vendor/pin/timing review.
